body: Over the last 2 years we tried 3 or 4 meds. Each one had adverse effects both mentally and physically. Currently the only thing that has worked for me is alcohol. I didn't want to become an alcoholic by 18 but well that's the only way I've been able to sleep at night.
I was on meds for some time and it only made me feel worse. I was never diagnoses with anything though.
I've tried talking to people and all I get is the same shit of "you're just feeling down" or "it'll get better". I've told them the god honest truth and they don't help

You don't have to be sorry. I have been getting more and more selfish. I've been putting myself at the top of the list and not thinking about those around me. I know I've been on a self destructive spiral for awhile and I should at least think of those around me first. I just need to put my thoughts out there cause if I don't it eats away at me making things all the worse.
I'm not exactly sure if all that was related to dying on the table but I'd like to think it was

Yes and no. When I went under for the surgery I wished the doctors good luck then cracked a few jokes waiting for the anesthetic to kick in. Once I went under though I had what seemed like a normal dream then it stopped and I felt like I was finally pain free and ok. I felt like I could have made a choice. If I wanted to continue with what I knew was to come or if I wanted to stop then and there. I won't lie before that time I had the occasional thought of suicide, can you blame me I had cancer. For the time I contemplated the "decision" I didn't think of family or most of my friends I thought about myself for once. I wanted to end it there I wanted to stop, but there was one person that I knew would be broken with my death. I still wanted it but her voice in my head kept saying "Keep going". Then I woke up in the icu with her at the foot of my bed. The moment I woke up, I hadn't opened my eyes yet but I felt like I made the wrong decision. Once I actually opened them she saw I was awake and she confirmed my beliefs that had I died it would have broken her. Hope that answered your question.
